welcome.title: 🎬 TELRO — your all-in-one assistant
welcome.body:
Hi {name} 👋
From video downloads to image generation and AI chat — everything in one fast, ad-free bot.
welcome.bullets:
📥 Send a link, I'll download it
🎵 Send a song name, I'll find it
🎨 Give me a prompt, I'll make an image
🤖 Ask me anything

access.banned: ⛔️ You have been blocked from using this bot.
access.maintenance: 🛠 The bot is under maintenance. Please come back in a few minutes.

download.title: 📥 Download from any link
download.intro: Just send me a link — YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, Reddit, SoundCloud and 1000+ sites supported by yt-dlp. ✅ Instant inspection + quality picker 🎵 Audio-only (MP3) option ⚡ Cached files are re-sent instantly 📦 Max size: {limit} Popular platforms: {platforms} Send a link now 👇

download.expired: ⌛️ This request expired. Send the link again.
download.not_link: This message has no link. Send a valid URL.
download.too_many: I'll process the first link only; send the rest separately.
download.quota:
📥 Your daily download quota is used up ({used}/{limit}).
It resets tomorrow, or get unlimited downloads with 💎 Premium.
download.playlist_title: 📚 {title} This link contains {count} videos. What should I download? Up to 10 items per request.
download.batch_failed: ❌ None of the {total} files could be downloaded.
download.audio_too_big: 🎵 The audio file exceeds the size limit.
download.share_text: 🎬 Download it with TELRO — fast, ad-free and in the best quality: {url} Tap the button below or forward this message 👇

music.title: 🎵 Music search
music.intro: Send a song or artist name; I'll find the best matches on YouTube and deliver MP3. Example: Shape of You Ed Sheeran You can also send a YouTube or Spotify link.
music.no_results: 😕 Nothing found for “{query}”. Check the spelling or try English.
music.expired: ⌛️ This search expired. Please search again.
music.need_query: Write the song name after the command. Example: /music Shape of You
music.too_short: The search query is too short.

ai.title: 🤖 TELRO AI
ai.intro:
Ask me anything — coding, translation, brainstorming or summaries.

📷 Send a photo and I'll analyse it.
🎤 Send a voice note (if enabled) and I'll transcribe it.

Use /exit to leave.
ai.mode_active: 🤖 Chat mode is on Send any message and I'll reply. Use /exit to return.

image.title: 🎨 TELRO image generator
image.intro: Describe anything you can imagine — in Persian or English. Example: an astronaut cat on Mars, cinematic, golden hour Pick an aspect ratio, then send your prompt 👇
image.need_prompt: Write the image prompt after the command. Example: /img a futuristic city at sunset
image.prompt: 🎨 Send your prompt or tap a button:
image.prompt_short: The prompt is too short; add a little detail.
image.unavailable: 📡 The image service is unavailable; try again.
image.not_configured: ⚙️ The image API key is not configured.
image.error: ❌ Image generation failed. Try another prompt.

help.title: ℹ️ TELRO help
help.body: An all-in-one Telegram bot: 📥 Download — send links from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, Reddit, SoundCloud, Aparat and 1000+ sites. 🎵 Music — send a song name or link and get MP3. 🤖 AI — ask questions, send photos, brainstorm. 🎨 Images — generate images from a prompt. 🎁 Invites — invite friends and earn Premium.
help.tips: 💡 Tips • Send links without a command — it's faster. • Duplicate files are re-sent instantly from cache. • Private Instagram needs cookies. • With a local Bot API server you can upload up to 2 GB. • In groups, mention or reply to the bot.

fallback.text:
I didn't get that 🤔
Send a link to download, or pick from the menu:
fallback.unsupported: I don't support this message type. Send a link or some text.

errors.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Try again.
errors.private: This content is private or requires login. If the link is public, try again.
errors.age: This content is age-restricted and Telegram won't allow downloading it.
errors.geo: This content is not available from our server (geo restriction).
errors.unsupported: This link is not supported. Try another one.
errors.unavailable: The content was removed or is unavailable.
errors.network: A network error occurred. Try again.
errors.forbidden: The site refused access (403). It may require cookies or a VPN.
errors.rate_limit: The site is rate-limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.disk: The server is out of disk space. Please contact the admin.
errors.ffmpeg: ffmpeg is not installed on the server; processing is unavailable.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than the allowed limit. Try a lower quality.
errors.upload: Uploading to Telegram failed. Try again.
errors.unsafe_url: This address is unsafe and was blocked.
errors.not_a_file: This link is not a direct file.
errors.playlist_inside: This is a playlist; use the playlist options.
errors.spotify: I couldn't find that Spotify track.
errors.spotify_playlist: Spotify support is currently limited to track or episode links.
